1.title: El-Sayed Apologizes for March Comment About Michigan Synagogue Attack
1.summary: Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, the Democratic Senate nominee in Michigan, faced criticism from Jewish Democrats after remarking, “hurt people hurt people.”

2.title: Milo Yiannopoulos, Right-Wing Agitator, Deported Home to U.K.
2.summary: Mr. Yiannopoulos, an early supporter of President Trump and vocal supporter of mass deportations, was himself sent back to his home country, part of a long fall from right-wing grace.

3.title: Trump hails 'historic' deal for US to control 65bn barrels of Venezuela's oil
3.summary: Venezuelan interim president says the unusual agreement will help revive her country's economy.

4.title: Canada installs large Lake Ontario sign in latest jab at US
4.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford unveiled a billboard on Canada's shoreline with the message: "Lake Ontario. Now and Always."

5.title: Search Continues for 2,400 Missing in Nepal Floods Amid ‘Immense’ Devastation
5.summary: As rescue efforts entered their fourth day, the scale of destruction came into focus, signaling a daunting recovery for the vulnerable nation.
